newsitem.title: USA: Penn National to offer 1.725 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Penn National to offer 1.725 mln shares.

text.p: Penn National Gaming on Wednesday said it would offer to the public 1.725 million common shares at $14.50 each.
The horse racetrack operator said it intended to use net proceeds from the sale to repay debt incurred in connection with the several acquisitions.

Those acquisitions were the Pocono Downs Racetrack outside Wilkes Barre, Pennsylvania, and off-track betting facilities in Allentown and Erie, Pennsylvania, and Charles Town Races, a thoroughbred racing facility in Jefferson County, West Virginia.
The offering will be made through an underwriting syndicate managed by Salomon Brothers Inc, Gerard Klauer Mattison & Co and Jefferies & Co.
The company on Thursday is scheduled to open its seventh off-track betting facility, located at the Lycoming Mall in Muncy Township, near Williamsport, Pennsylvania.
